dct_description_sm: Abstract: This point layer contains start and end nodes for all of the street segments in Cambridge. It also contains street names for all intersections.
Purpose: Created in accompaniment with the Centerlines data layer. Each street segment has a "from node" and a "to node" to connect the streets and to indicate the direction of the segment.

Supplemental information: The intersection nodes in this layer mark the 1496 points where two or more streets meet, as well as the 367 ends of streets (dead ends, cul-de-sacs, and truncated segments crossing the city boundary).
